from mistune.toc import render_toc_ul

def render_toc_ul(toc: Iterable[Tuple[int, str, str]], ordered: bool = False) -> str: """Render a
    or
      table of content HTML. The param "toc" should be formatted into this structure:: [ (level, id, text), ] For example:: [ (1, 'toc-intro', 'Introduction'), (2, 'toc-install', 'Install'), (2, 'toc-upgrade', 'Upgrade'), (1, 'toc-license', 'License'), ] """ if not toc: return "" list_tag = "ol" if ordered else "ul" parts: List[str] = [] levels: List[int] = [] for level, k, text in toc: item = f'{text}' if not levels: parts.append("
    1. ") parts.append(item) levels.append(level) elif level == levels[-1]: parts.append("
      2. \n
    2. ") parts.append(item) elif level > levels[-1]: parts.append(f"\n<{list_tag}>\n
    3. ") parts.append(item) levels.append(level) else: levels.pop() while levels: last_level = levels.pop() if level == last_level: parts.append(f"
      4. \n\n\n
    4. ") parts.append(item) levels.append(level) break elif level > last_level: parts.append("
      5. \n
    5. ") parts.append(item) levels.append(last_level) levels.append(level) break else: parts.append(f"
      6. \n\n") else: levels.append(level) parts.append("\n
    6. ") parts.append(item) while len(levels) > 1: parts.append(f"
      7. \n\n") levels.pop() if not parts: return "" parts.append("\n") return f"<{list_tag}>\n" + "".join(parts) + f"\n"
